The LLM asks whether restarts, 5xx or Unhealthy began on that workload (or that ingress) within ±30 minutes of a change. If they overlap, write "Y started after change X — rollback candidate"; if the material is instant values and times cannot be matched, write "correlation not verifiable (range query needed)". If nothing overlaps, finish in one line. Do not assert.
